newsitem.title: USA: Casino America stake cut by Crown.
newsitem.headline: Casino America stake cut by Crown.

text.p: Crown Casino Corp said Thursday it cut its stake in Casino America Inc to 1,885,086 common shares or 8.1 percent from 14 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Crown said its latest transactions include the sale of 649,700 common shares sold between Oct 7 and Oct 21 at prices ranging from $6.20 to $7.03125 per share.
Also in October Crown sold a $10 million Casino promissory note, to which the warrants to purchase 833,334 shares were attached, the filing said. The warrants were transferred for no consideration.
The Biloxi, Miss., company is a developer, owner and operator of dockside and riverboat casinos and related facilities in the United States.
